relative_position: variable.beam.direction_x * variable.beam.speed * (variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime) + math.sin(variable.particle_age * 900 + variable.particle_random_1 * 360) * 0.25 * (1 - variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime)

variable.beam.direction_y * variable.beam.speed * (variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime) + math.cos(variable.particle_age * 900 + variable.particle_random_1 * 360) * 0.25 * (1 - variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime)

variable.beam.direction_z * variable.beam.speed * (variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime) + math.sin(variable.particle_age * 900 + variable.particle_random_1 * 360) * 0.25 * (1 - variable.particle_age / variable.particle_lifetime)
